title: Part-time Events and Catering Coordinator
description:
The Events and Catering Co-ordinator will facilitate the coordination of the company s calendar of events and will assist with delivery and record keeping of catering and event services (external and internal) alongside the Events and Catering Teams.

This role will also involve providing administrative support to internal and external dinners, working closely within the catering and events team. Reporting to, and working closely with, the Head of Catering, youwill ensure the timely and effective processing of information relating to event and catering operations, from initial point of enquiry to final invoicing. They will work as part of a team to ensure that the College provides a consistently excellent standard of catering and hospitality service.

Working hours are 20 hours per week, ideally worked over 5 days, Monday Friday, including very occasional evening and weekend work, for which time overtime is paid. Flexibility towards the desired hours can be discussed at interview.

Holiday - Pro-rata of 38 days per annum (including Bank Holidays and closure days). Some holiday must be taken during closure periods in August-September and December.

Key responsibilities may include:

Provide administrative support for the Kitchen and Front of House and Events teams; producing and printing menus, signage, responding to emails and carrying out administrative projects and arrangements as required

Assist in administration required for internal and external events

Carry out show rounds of the facilities and have detailed information to hand to answer questions

Handle enquiries and room bookings

Work collaboratively with the Catering team, ensuring the effective communication of all details relating to events involving hospitality

Liaise with relevant departments over bookings, timings, diet plans, IT, AV and all other details of events

Process enquiries (external and Internal). To prepare quotations for events, follow up to the point of confirmation, billing and feedback

Assist in producing and maintaining of sources of information on the website/intranet and in publications

Supporting the Head Chef and Food and Beverage Manager with the admin associated with stock taking of the college kitchen, pantry, wine cellar and bar. This will consist of inputting data and ensuring it is all up to date

Customer focused approach to all events and conferences, including initial response to any queries

Other Responsibilities:

Provide day-to-day administrative and operational support across catering systems and databases, including maintaining records, processing updates, producing reports, supporting till and booking system operations, and assisting with general system coordination and issue resolution.

Comply with the college s policies and procedures including Health and Safety policies.

The position may require the post holder to work outside normal office hours from time to time.

Assisting the Food and Beverage Manager and Head Chef with coordinating payroll documentation for all catering departments, including casual and agency workers into HR system and other admin tasks

Occasionally working across departments for supporting other teams within reason

Carry out other tasks as reasonably requested by the Head of Catering and Events Manager, which could include projects and event planning for other departments.

Person Specification

Essential

Sound administrative and organisational experience, particularly within conferences and events is preferable

Proven ability to accept responsibility and the self-motivation to see a project through to completion

Excellent written and interpersonal skills

Meticulously accurate worker with good attention to detail

Understanding and experience of catering

Ability to work independently and flexibly as a member of a small team

Ability to work under pressure

Effective communicator and problem solver

Flexible and able to work occasional evenings and weekends

IT literacy including Microsoft Office

Good experience with Excel and spreadsheets

Desirable

Experience of Perfect Table Plan, Mercury, Zoom, and other event platforms

A background in hospitality or the events industry

Flexible and able to work occasional evenings and weekends

Knowledge of Social Media

Experience using AI platforms

Experience with minute taking

title: Administrator
description:
Assessment Administrator (12-Month Fixed-Term Contract)

Hybrid Working 12-Month Fixed-Term Contract Competitive Salary + Excellent Benefits

Are you an experienced administrator with exceptional organisational skills and a talent for coordinating multiple processes at once?

We're looking for a highly organised and detail-focused professional to join a busy operations team on a 12-month fixed-term contract. This is a varied and rewarding role where you'll play a key part in supporting the delivery of professional qualifications and assessments, ensuring processes run smoothly, accurately, and to strict deadlines.

Working within a collaborative team, you'll liaise with a wide range of stakeholders including learners, employers, contractors, assessors, and external partners, providing first-class support and ensuring a positive experience throughout the assessment journey.

The Role

As a key member of the team, you will be responsible for coordinating assessment-related activities, supporting candidates and external stakeholders, and ensuring critical processes are delivered accurately and on time.

Key responsibilities include:
- Coordinating assessment administration and ensuring the accuracy of data and documentation.
- Providing first-line support to candidates and external partners via phone, email, and Microsoft Teams.
- Managing high-volume shared inboxes and responding to enquiries in a professional and timely manner.
- Supporting assessment delivery, including liaising with external centres and resolving issues as they arise.
- Maintaining accurate records and updating internal and external systems.
- Processing and validating data with a high level of attention to detail.
- Coordinating communications with external stakeholders, contractors, examiners, and assessors.
- Organising meetings, preparing documentation, and supporting administrative projects.
- Handling confidential and sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
- Supporting investigations, evidence gathering, and case administration where required.
- Assisting with the administration of professional courses, seminars, and development programmes.

About You

We're looking for a strong administrator with excellent coordination experience who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys managing multiple priorities.

Essential Skills & Experience
- Previous experience in a busy administration, coordination, or operations support role.
- Strong coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and competing priorities.
- Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accuracy.
- Outstanding organisational and time management skills.
- Strong customer service and stakeholder management experience.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Confident IT user with strong Microsoft Office skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.
- Experience handling sensitive and confidential information.
- A proactive, adaptable, and solution-focused approach.

Desirable
- Experience within a professional membership body, education, training, examinations, or assessment environment.
- Experience working with external stakeholders, volunteers, or contractors.

title: Receptionist

Be all you can be with Hamberley
At Hamberley, we believe that our residents deserve something 'Extra Special, Every Day' and we're recruiting for a Receptionist to help us achieve our goals.
Working as our receptionist, you will be responsible for the Reception area of the home, ensuring this is presented to a high standard at all times.
Joining us at Chawley Grove, our luxury care home that provides residential, dementia, and nursing care for older people, you'll be part of a team that is genuinely passionate about the health and well-being of our residents.
Working Pattern: 24 hours per week across Friday, Saturday and Sunday, with shift start times of either 8:30am-5:00pm or 9:00am-5:30pm.
We offer our colleagues
- A competitive salary and benefits package
- 28 days holiday inclusive of Bank Holidays
- Quality-linked bonus scheme - A performance bonus tied to our CQC/CI quality rating, rewarding you for helping us deliver outstanding care.
- Workplace pension for your future security
- A true team culture - A collaborative, encouraging working environment where kindness, respect, and professional pride are at the heart of everything we do
- Excellent training and career development opportunities
- Employee Assistance Programme, occupational health and wellbeing support services
- Everyday saving perks - Access to a wide range of retail discounts and savings
- Free on-site parking
- Rewarding connections - Refer a Friend bonus - earn up to £750 per successful referral because great people know great people.

What you'll be doing:
- Greeting and directing visitors, family members, residents, district nurses and contractors to the home and around the home as appropriate.
- Be the first point of contact for visitors and third parties contacting the home, ensuring queries are dealt with and/or directed in a timely manner.
- Answering incoming telephone calls, ensuring calls are documented and/or redirected accordingly.

Could you be part of our team?
About you:
- Possess demonstrable experience working within a Customer Service/Receptionist and/or Administrative environment or similar role.
- Proficient in use of Microsoft Office, particularly Word and Excel.
- A caring, patient, and respectful demeanor.

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- To share our values and demonstrate them at all times. "Can-Do" flexible team worker, problem solver, passion for what they do, ability to manage diverse and demanding workload, think out of the box, open to doing things differently.

Chawley Grove is a luxurious care home in Oxford, part of the award-winning Hamberley Care Homes - offering luxury care homes in beautiful locations throughout the UK. Residents live in spacious, stylish ensuite rooms, and enjoy beautifully furnished shared spaces and landscaped gardens. From the deluxe picture house - where we screen classic films - to the on-site luxury spa - offering hairdressing, manicures and relaxing therapies - everything has been designed and finished with the care and attention you would expect from a 5-star hotel.

Administrative Support

Experience with financial accounts, reconciliation and budgeting processes

Forensic attention to detail

Excellent organisational skills with the ability to multi-task

Ability to interpret and understand the business

The ability to deliver quality output to strict deadlines

Articulate communicator across all mediums

Confidence to work under own initiative

title: Office Coordinator
description:
As Office Coordinator you will be joining a family owned and run beautiful rural estate. The estate receives more than 100,000 visitors a year and hosts a wide range programme of events including festivals, weddings, film location, corporate and private parties. The role is full time, permanent working on site in Henley-on-Thames offering a salary of up to 28,000 with standard office hours Monday to Friday.

Purpose of the role:

Reporting to the General Manager, you will be supporting the administration function of the estate office, commercial let offices and business operations.

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities for the Office Coordinator:
- Being first point of contact for enquiries
- Facilities administration
- Historic house management: liaising with architects, other advisers and conservation specialists as required
- Manage the ticketing system, group bookings and corporate event bookings
- Overseeing maintenance and utility agreements for the house, office and parkland
- Fleet management including lease agreements, MOTs, servicing etc
- Act as intermediary for property portfolio, liaise with leaseholders for commercial and residential properties, coordinating repairs and refurbishment projects
- Support with Health & Safety activities
- Maintain CRM database
- Source goods and services as required
- Assist with updating and maintaining the website including e-newsletter
- Support with planning inhouse events, interacting with external hirers, liaising with organisers, helping with supervision of event staff and contractors
- Responding to booking enquiries, taking bookings, maintain spreadsheets detailing catering requirements

Key Skills Required for the Office Coordinator:
- Strong organised administration experience
- Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously
- High levels of accuracy and attention to detail
- Confident communicator with high levels of customer care
- Ability to build positive working relationships with internal and external teams
- Adaptable in a changing environment
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, file management systems
- Experience of ticket booking systems would be an advantage
- Own transport due to remote location

What's in it for you?

Offering a salary of up to 28,000 standard office hours Monday to Friday, discounts on food and events. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a friendly and collaborative team and to be part of this historic estate, working with the family to maintain this beautiful estate to be enjoyed for future generations.
